results.name: squad_activate_by_reference
results.evidence: Decodes an encoded ai-reference (top 2 bits of param_1 select type 0/1/2, low 16 bits = squad id, byte 2 = sub-index, matching the same reference encoding used by the get/set helpers later in this file) and forwards the decoded fields to FUN_00437510; FUN_00435d50 calls the same FUN_00437510(id,-1,-1) as part of activating all pending squads at load time.
results.summary: Unpacks a packed squad/ai reference value and forwards it to an internal squad-activation routine (FUN_00437510).

results.name: squad_members_apply_callback
results.evidence: Guards on an implicit register handle (in_EAX) then walks a squad-member iterator pair (FUN_00432650/FUN_004326d0) calling FUN_004289c0(local_8,0) for each entry.
results.summary: For each member produced by a squad iterator, invokes a per-member callback with an uninitialized/garbage secondary argument.

results.name: squad_member_index_dispatch
results.evidence: Same encoded ai-reference decode as FUN_00432b80 (top 2 bits select type), extracting the sub-index byte at offset 2 and always forwarding it unchanged to FUN_0042ab00.
results.summary: Decodes the sub-index byte of a packed ai reference and passes it to FUN_0042ab00.

results.name: squad_reference_resolve_actor
results.evidence: Decodes the packed ai-reference; for type==1 it scans the design-time squad's actor-placement array (encounter block at DAT_00746f8c+0x430, stride 0xb0, sub-array at +0x84 stride 0xe8) comparing field+0x22 against the reference's sub-index byte, returning the matching slot index or falling back to FUN_00438f60 when not found.
results.summary: Resolves a packed squad/actor reference to a concrete actor-placement slot index within the owning encounter's squad definition.

results.name: squad_members_respawn_if_assigned
results.evidence: Walks the squad-member iterator (FUN_00432650/FUN_004326d0) and, for members whose fields +0x18 or +0x24 are not -1 (i.e. an object/order is already assigned), calls FUN_00432df0, the shared per-member respawn worker.
results.summary: Re-spawns squad members that already have an assigned object or order reference.

results.name: squad_data_respawn_all
results.evidence: Uses the generic data_iterator_next() helper (already named in another batch) to walk a datum set and call FUN_00432df0 (the shared respawn worker) for every entry while a handle in unaff_ESI is valid.
results.summary: Iterates a datum collection via data_iterator_next and respawns every member found.

results.name: squad_member_respawn
results.evidence: For each squad member from the FUN_00432650/FUN_004326d0 iterator with a valid object slot (field+0x34), writes state value 0x96 into the runtime squad record (DAT_008802c8, stride 0x6c, field+0xe) and calls FUN_00437710, then always creates a new entry via FUN_0043eb30(...,1,0) and hands it to FUN_0042a3a0 when valid.
results.summary: Worker that tears down an existing squad member placement (marking it with state 0x96) and creates its replacement.

results.name: squad_group_respawn_members
results.evidence: Uses the recurring bucket/node hash pair DAT_0087a464 (buckets) + DAT_0087a468 (node pool, 0xc-byte nodes: payload at +4, next at +8) keyed by in_EAX to walk a chain of associated squads, calling FUN_00432df0 (the respawn worker) for each.
results.summary: Walks all squads associated with a given key in an internal hash map and respawns each one via FUN_00432df0.

results.name: squad_design_members_set_flag_0x11
results.evidence: Walks a second iterator pair (FUN_004324f0/FUN_004325b0, distinct from FUN_00432650/FUN_004326d0) and sets byte field+0x11 to 1 for every yielded record, guarded by an implicit handle (in_EAX).
results.summary: Sets a byte flag at offset 0x11 on every record produced by the design-squad-member iterator.

results.name: squad_design_members_apply_callback
results.evidence: Same FUN_004324f0/FUN_004325b0 iterator as FUN_00432f10 but instead calls FUN_00439270() unconditionally for every entry.
results.summary: Invokes a per-record callback (FUN_00439270) for every entry from the design-squad-member iterator.

results.name: ai_reference_get_stat
results.evidence: Decodes param_1 exactly like the other packed ai-reference consumers (top 2 bits = squad/starting-location/formation selector) and, depending on a hidden selector register (unaff_DI: 0, 1, or other), returns one of two 16-bit fields or their clamped non-negative difference from the matching squad/starting-location/formation record, plus out-params for an associated int (param_2) and a datum handle (param_3).
results.summary: Given a packed ai reference, fetches one of two related 16-bit stat fields (or their difference) from the referenced squad, starting-location, or formation record, plus an object index and datum handle.

results.name: squad_starting_location_range_in_use
results.evidence: Uses squad record (DAT_008802c8, stride 0x6c) field+8 as a base index into the starting-location array (DAT_008802c4, stride 0x10) and, for a range [local_8, local_4) produced by FUN_00432420, returns 1 as soon as any entry's leading byte is non-zero, else 0.
results.summary: Checks whether any starting-location entry in a squad's given index range is marked in use (non-zero leading byte).

results.name: squad_starting_location_range_clear
results.evidence: Same squad+starting-location addressing as FUN_00433180 (DAT_008802c8 stride 0x6c, DAT_008802c4 stride 0x10) but writes 0 into the leading byte of every entry in the decoded range.
results.summary: Clears the leading (in-use) byte of every starting-location entry in a squad's index range.

results.name: squad_starting_location_range_mark_used
results.evidence: Identical addressing to FUN_00433200 but writes 1 instead of 0 into the leading byte of each starting-location entry in range.
results.summary: Marks every starting-location entry in a squad's index range as used (leading byte = 1).

results.name: squad_starting_location_range_set_reserved
results.evidence: Same squad/starting-location range walk as FUN_00433200/270 but sets the byte at offset +1 (rather than +0) to 1 for every entry in range.
results.summary: Sets a second per-entry flag byte (offset +1) on every starting-location entry in a squad's index range.

results.name: squad_starting_location_range_set_enabled
results.evidence: Same range walk again, writing a bool at offset +2 equal to (param_1 == 0), i.e. an externally supplied flag inverted into a per-entry boolean.
results.summary: Sets a per-entry boolean (offset +2) on every starting-location entry in a squad's index range based on the caller-supplied flag.

results.name: squad_find_matching_actor_variant_member
results.evidence: Iterates a design squad's actor-placement array (encounter block DAT_00746f8c+0x430 stride 0xb0, sub-array +0x84 stride 0xe8) and, for each candidate, resolves a tag instance through the DAT_0087bc14 tag table (stride 0x20, offset+0x14 = definition pointer) checking the group tag equals 0x61637476 ('actv' = actor_variant), then ranks candidates by: exact index match (param_1/param_4), exact parent-variant match (param_3), exact variant match (param_2), matching variant type field (+0x14), else first available.
results.summary: Scans a squad's design member list for the best actor_variant match against requested index/variant/parent criteria, returning the chosen member's slot index.

results.name: squad_reassign_members_between_squads
results.evidence: Takes a destination squad (param_1) and source squad (in_EDX), for each design member resolves the current actor_variant tag via the DAT_0087bc14 tag table and calls FUN_004333d0 to find a matching member in the other squad; on success calls FUN_004290f0 to reassign it, optionally triggers FUN_0042d340 (a dialogue/event id 0x17-based call), retargets the leader flag at squad+0x1e, and re-links starting-location owners in the DAT_00880360 (stride 0x724) actor array.
results.summary: Merges/reassigns live squad members from one squad into another, matching by actor_variant, transferring leader status and starting-location ownership.

results.name: unit_reassign_actor_squad_member
results.evidence: Resolves a unit's actor via the object header table (DAT_008603b0) reading fields +500/+0x1f8 (actor index), computes whether the actor's current squad (DAT_00880360 stride 0x724, field+0x34) equals param_1, and uses FUN_004333d0 to find a replacement design-member slot before calling FUN_004290f0 and, if requested, FUN_00423600(0).
results.summary: Re-maps a unit's controlling actor onto a matching member slot of a target squad, notifying via FUN_00423600 when requested.

results.name: squad_group_reassign_members
results.evidence: Walks the DAT_0087a464/DAT_0087a468 bucket+node hash keyed by in_ECX, resolving each node as an actor datum (inlined datum_get pattern against DAT_008603b0) and calling FUN_00433970 for it, then follows a secondary linked list via fields +0x118/+0x114 to reassign related actors the same way.
results.summary: For every actor associated with a key (directly or via a linked chain), reassigns its squad-member mapping via FUN_00433970.

results.name: actor_type_compare_and_notify
results.evidence: Compares param_1 against an implicit register value (in_AX), special-casing the value 1 as a wildcard and requiring exact equality for values 2 and 5, then reports the boolean result to FUN_0045be50.
results.summary: Compares two type/category values with a wildcard rule and reports the match result to FUN_0045be50.

results.name: object_sort_by_flag_then_distance
results.evidence: Pure two-int-pointer comparator (no implicit registers) used directly as the qsort callback in FUN_00433cc0: orders by boolean field at offset+8 first (false before true), then ascending by float distance at offset+4.
results.summary: qsort comparator that orders candidate objects by a boolean flag first, then by ascending squared distance.

results.name: squad_investigate_nearby_objects
results.evidence: Gets the calling object's position via object_try_and_get(3)/object_get_position, calls FUN_0056a310 to gather nearby objects into a local buffer, sorts them with object_sort_by_flag_then_distance (flagging object type 9), then iterates nearest-first calling FUN_0040e260 until a flagged object is hit (unless param_3 overrides).
results.summary: Finds objects near the current object, sorts them by distance (deprioritizing type-9 objects), and processes them nearest-first via FUN_0040e260.

results.name: squad_count_members_by_type_and_group
results.evidence: Pure single-int-parameter function (no implicit registers) that walks the FUN_00436a70 iterator counting entries whose field+0x6c equals 9 and field+0x9c equals param_1.
results.summary: Counts iterator entries matching a fixed type value (9) and a caller-supplied group/id field.

results.name: squad_members_update_weapon_state
results.evidence: Zero-argument routine (no implicit registers) walking the squad-member iterator (FUN_00432650/FUN_004326d0); for each live unit it resolves the actor via the object header table, checks weapon-slot fields (+0x47 weapon index, +0xbc weapon-palette index), calls matrix4x3_multiply to compute an attach transform, toggles object_for_each_light_attachment, clears an attach flag bit, and drives unit_try_set_animation_state(...,0x25) / unit_set_custom_animation, consistent with holstering/detaching a unit's held weapon.
results.summary: Iterates active squad members and updates each unit's weapon-holster/attach state, including transform, light attachments, and holster animation.

results.name: squad_members_set_combat_status
results.evidence: Walks the squad-member iterator; for param_1==0 raises an actor's status field (DAT_00880360 stride 0x724, offset+0x6a) from 0 to 2, otherwise resets +0x6a/+0x6c to 0 and calls FUN_00427e00/FUN_00429000/FUN_00427860 (a reset sequence).
results.summary: Raises or clears a per-member combat-status field, resetting related state when clearing.

results.name: squad_group_set_combat_status
results.evidence: Same status-field manipulation as FUN_00434500 (offset +0x6a/+0x6c on the DAT_00880360 actor record) but applied to every actor reachable through the DAT_0087a464/DAT_0087a468 group hash and its secondary +0x118/+0x114 linked chain.
results.summary: Applies the same combat-status set/clear logic as squad_members_set_combat_status across an entire squad group.

results.name: squad_group_actors_set_flag_0x400
results.evidence: Walks the DAT_0087a464/DAT_0087a468 group hash resolving each node to an actor via the inlined datum_get pattern against DAT_008603b0, then sets or clears bit 0x400 of the actor's flags field at offset+0x204 depending on param_1.
results.summary: Sets or clears flag bit 0x400 on the flags field of every actor in a squad group.

results.name: squad_group_actors_set_flag_0x800
results.evidence: Identical structure to FUN_004347b0 but toggles bit 0x800 of the same actor flags field at offset+0x204.
results.summary: Sets or clears flag bit 0x800 on the flags field of every actor in a squad group.

results.name: squad_members_face_default_direction
results.evidence: For eligible squad members (no active order, or an idle check via FUN_0055aa20), looks up an angle field (design squad actor array stride 0xe8, offset+0xd4, indexed via FUN_00437220) and computes cos/sin to build a facing vector, passing it to FUN_004f51c0/FUN_004f5160/FUN_00417570.
results.summary: Orients idle squad members to face a designer-specified default direction taken from their squad placement data.

results.name: squad_members_update_grenade_state
results.evidence: Zero-argument (no implicit registers) walk of the squad-member iterator; converts unit stat fields +0xd8/+0xdc into boolean floats at +0xe0/+0xe4, then advances a classic LCG PRNG (DAT_00719cd0 * 0x19660d + 0x3c6ef35f) to pick a randomized grenade-related count between per-type min/max fields and stores it back into byte fields +0x31c/+0x31d/+0x31e of the unit.
results.summary: Updates per-member derived combat booleans and randomizes a grenade-count style counter using an LCG PRNG.

results.name: squad_members_clear_search_target
results.evidence: Zero-argument function (no implicit registers) that walks the squad-member iterator and sets a 16-bit search-target-type field at offset+0x1d4 to 0 for every member; paired with FUN_00434cc0 (=1, with data) and FUN_00434d00 (=2), suggesting a 3-state search-target enum.
results.summary: Clears the search-target type field on every squad member (search-target enum value 0 = none).

results.name: squad_members_set_search_target_point
results.evidence: Same field as FUN_00434c80 (offset+0x1d4) but sets it to 1 and also writes a 4-byte value from an implicit register (unaff_ESI) into offset+0x1d8, matching a 'point/object reference' payload for search-target type 1.
results.summary: Sets every squad member's search-target type to 1 (point) and stores an associated reference value.

results.name: squad_members_set_search_target_area
results.evidence: Same field as FUN_00434c80/cc0 (offset+0x1d4) set to 2 with no associated payload write, and no implicit registers used, matching a parameterless 'area' search-target state.
results.summary: Sets every squad member's search-target type to 2 (area), with no additional payload.

results.name: squad_members_set_flag_0x1cb
results.evidence: Pure single-char-parameter function (no implicit registers) walking the squad-member iterator, writing a bool at offset+0x1cb equal to (param_1 == 0) for every member.
results.summary: Sets a per-member boolean flag (offset 0x1cb) on every squad member based on a caller-supplied byte.

results.name: squad_members_start_fleeing_if_ready
results.evidence: Walks the squad-member iterator calling the predicate FUN_00407140 on each; when true, calls actor_set_mode(member, 0xb, buffer) - mode 0xb matches the same actor-mode value checked as a 'currently fleeing' state elsewhere in this file (e.g. FUN_00434f20).
results.summary: For each squad member, if a readiness predicate (FUN_00407140) is satisfied, switches the actor into mode 0xb (consistent with a flee state).

results.name: unit_actor_start_fleeing_if_ready
results.evidence: Single-unit variant of FUN_00434d90: resolves the unit's actor via object_try_and_get(3) and field+500, applies the same FUN_00407140 predicate, and calls actor_set_mode(actor,0xb,buffer) on success.
results.summary: For one specific unit's actor, switches it into mode 0xb (flee) if the readiness predicate FUN_00407140 is satisfied.

results.name: squad_members_notify_event
results.evidence: Zero-argument walk of the squad-member iterator calling FUN_00407040(local_8, 0, &LAB_00406f80, 0) for every member, registering LAB_00406f80 as a callback; local_8 is read uninitialized so its true source is an untracked register from the iterator.
results.summary: Registers a fixed callback (LAB_00406f80) against every squad member via FUN_00407040.

results.name: actor_type_get_morale_grade
results.evidence: Register-parameter helper (in_AX = actor-type/difficulty index, in_EDX = pointer into a per-type morale record) that indexes a tag table (DAT_00746f8c+0x43c, stride 0x60) and, if in range, derives a value of 2 or 3 from a flag bit in *(in_EDX+4), else returns 1; called only from FUN_00434f20's morale/threat computation.
results.summary: Looks up a per-actor-type morale/threat grade (1-3) from tag data, used by the squad morale calculation.

results.name: squad_group_get_max_morale
results.evidence: Walks the DAT_0087a464/DAT_0087a468 group hash from in_EAX, resolving each squad member's actor and, depending on whether its mode field (+0x6c) equals 0xb (fleeing), either calls actor_type_get_morale_grade or checks a last-damage tick (DAT_006f1d6c+0xc) against a stored timestamp (+0x94) to flag danger, tracking the maximum value seen across the whole group.
results.summary: Computes the highest morale/danger grade across all actors belonging to a squad group, used to drive flee/retreat decisions.

results.name: squad_members_alert_to_attacker
results.evidence: Walks the squad-member iterator calling FUN_00428650/FUN_00436620(0); when a global attacker record (DAT_00880354) is valid, copies its object reference into the member's actor record (DAT_00880360 stride 0x724, offset+0x2c), sets a has-target byte (+9), and derives an aim-limit field (+0x10, 0 or 0x5a) from a team-membership check.
results.summary: Propagates a globally-recorded attacker as the current target to every squad member, setting target and aim-limit fields.

results.name: squad_group_alert_to_attacker
results.evidence: Same target-propagation logic as FUN_004351c0 (offset+0x2c target, +9 has-target flag, +0x10 aim-limit) but applied across the DAT_0087a464/DAT_0087a468 group hash rather than a single squad, tallying how many members were updated (sVar1) before calling FUN_00435f00.
results.summary: Propagates a globally-recorded attacker as the target across every member of a squad group.

results.name: actor_initialize_defaults
results.evidence: Validates a candidate unit via object_try_and_get(1) and a flags check (+0x106 bit 2 clear), obtains a fresh actor slot via FUN_00426760, and writes a batch of default field values (offsets 0x6a,0x60,0x62,0x8e,0x92,0x90,0x68) into the new actor record before branching on a per-type table (PTR_PTR_006853b8) to either reset (FUN_00427e60) or assign (FUN_00427560) it.
results.summary: Allocates and initializes a fresh actor record with default combat/status field values for a newly recognized unit.

results.name: unit_actor_set_target_response
results.evidence: Resolves a unit's actor via the object header table (DAT_008603b0) and, if the actor's has-target byte (+9, the same field set by squad_members_alert_to_attacker) is non-zero, writes param_1 into the adjacent byte field (+0xa).
results.summary: Sets a response/behavior byte on a unit's actor, but only while it currently has an active target.

results.name: squad_members_assign_team_and_request_order
results.evidence: For team index unaff_SI in range 0..11, walks the squad-member iterator, looks up each member's order-index field (+0x6c) in a per-order team table (DAT_00655258, stride 0x38), writes unaff_SI into the member's team field (+0x62), and calls actor_process_order_request(member,-1) when uncommitted (+0x6e==0) and the looked-up order category is 0, 1, or 2.
results.summary: Assigns a team id to every squad member and re-requests a default order for members whose current order category qualifies.

results.name: squad_members_request_order
results.evidence: Same team-index range guard (0..11) and squad-member iterator as FUN_00435590, but unconditionally calls actor_process_order_request(member) for every member.
results.summary: Requests an order re-evaluation for every squad member.

results.name: squad_get_activity_level
results.evidence: Reads a chain of squad-record fields (DAT_00880360 stride 0x724: +8 valid byte, +0x6a order stage, +0x6e commit flag, +0x268 counters, +0x454/+0x45c flags) returning an increasing stage value 0-6, used by FUN_00435700 to compute a maximum across squads.
results.summary: Classifies a squad's current processing/combat activity into an ordinal stage from 0 (inactive) to 6 (fully engaged).

results.name: encounter_get_max_squad_activity_level
results.evidence: Zero-argument function (no implicit registers) walking the squad iterator (FUN_00432650/FUN_004326d0) and taking the maximum of squad_get_activity_level (FUN_00435680) over all squads.
results.summary: Computes the highest activity level among all of an encounter's squads.

results.name: unit_actor_set_squad_slot_reference
results.evidence: Pure two-parameter function (no implicit registers): resolves param_1's actor via the object header table (DAT_008603b0), decodes param_2 as a packed ai-reference (design-squad actor-array lookup for type 1, or a raw byte index for type 2) to find a design-member slot, stores it into the actor's fields +0x334/+0x336, and, the first time it is set, walks the global actor list (DAT_00880354 head, node stride 0x724, next at +0x2c) notifying other actors whose target field (+0x158) equals param_1 via FUN_004290f0.
results.summary: Records which design squad-member slot a unit's actor corresponds to, and notifies other actors that were targeting it.
results.prototype: void __cdecl unit_actor_set_squad_slot_reference(unsigned int param_1, unsigned int param_2)

results.name: ai_get_or_create_unit_record
results.evidence: Linear-searches a fixed 32-entry table (DAT_00880354+0x3b8, stride 0x28, count at +0x3b6) for an entry keyed by unaff_EDI, and if not found (and room remains) allocates a new slot, zeroing 10 dwords, storing the key at [0] and the float constant 8.0 (0x41000000) at [1].
results.summary: Finds or allocates a per-object record in a small fixed table, initializing a new entry with a default 8.0 timer value.

results.name: ai_remove_unit_record
results.evidence: Searches the same fixed table as FUN_00435900 (DAT_00880354+0x3b8, stride 0x28) for an entry matching in_EAX and removes it via swap-with-last, decrementing the count at +0x3b6.
results.summary: Removes a per-object record from the fixed table populated by ai_get_or_create_unit_record.

results.name: actor_send_message_event
results.evidence: Validates the unit has an actor (object header table DAT_008603b0, field+500 != -1) then calls FUN_004142d0(0xd, 1, local_10) with local_10[0]=6, matching the shape of a dialogue/HUD message dispatch call (message-type id, count, parameter block).
results.summary: Dispatches a fixed dialogue/message event (type 0xd, parameter 6) for a unit that has an associated actor.

results.name: unit_actor_reset_combat_timers
results.evidence: Resolves a unit's actor via the object header table (DAT_008603b0) and zeroes three adjacent 16-bit fields (+0x544, +0x546, +0x548) in the actor record (DAT_00880360 stride 0x724).
results.summary: Clears a group of three timer/counter fields on a unit's actor record.

results.name: squad_design_members_set_byte_field_0x10
results.evidence: Walks the FUN_004324f0/FUN_004325b0 design-member iterator (same one used by FUN_00432f10's offset+0x11 setter) writing an implicit register byte (unaff_BL) into offset+0x10 of every record.
results.summary: Sets a byte field (offset 0x10) on every design-squad-member record to a caller-supplied value passed in a register.

results.name: squad_members_invoke_callback
results.evidence: Guards on an implicit handle (in_EAX) then walks the squad-member iterator (FUN_00432650/FUN_004326d0) calling FUN_00421a40() unconditionally for each entry.
results.summary: Invokes a fixed callback (FUN_00421a40) for every squad member.

results.name: squad_set_field_and_notify_members
results.evidence: Writes a caller-supplied short (in_CX) into the squad record (DAT_008802c8 stride 0x6c, offset+2), then, if a global list (DAT_00880354) is active, walks the squad's member chain through the DAT_00880360 (stride 0x724) actor array's next-pointer (+0x2c) calling FUN_004276e0 for each before finishing with FUN_0042bbb0.
results.summary: Updates a short field on a squad record and notifies all of its current members.

results.name: squad_design_members_set_flag_0x14
results.evidence: Pure single-char-parameter function (no implicit registers) walking the FUN_004324f0/FUN_004325b0 design-member iterator, writing a bool at offset+0x14 equal to (param_1 == 0) for every record.
results.summary: Sets a per-record boolean flag (offset 0x14) on every design-squad-member record based on a caller-supplied byte.

results.name: encounters_initialize
results.evidence: Retains its confirmed PDB/string-matched name; creates the 'encounter' (squads) and 'ai pursuit' datum arrays via FUN_005380d0 and reserves two scratch buffers from the level's dynamic memory pool via DAT_006e2dc8/DAT_006e2dcc, updating the level CRC via crc32_update.
results.summary: Initializes the runtime squad ('encounter') and 'ai pursuit' datum arrays and reserves their backing scratch buffers for a loaded scenario.

results.name: encounters_reset
results.evidence: Zero-argument function (no implicit registers) mirroring encounters_initialize's globals: marks DAT_008802c8 and DAT_008802d0 for full deletion and calls data_delete_all() on each, zeroes the two scratch buffers reserved by encounters_initialize (DAT_008802cc for 0x8000 bytes, DAT_008802c4 for 0x1000 bytes), then calls FUN_00437060 once per tag encounter block to rebuild runtime squads.
results.summary: Tears down all runtime squads and ai-pursuit data and rebuilds the squad set from the scenario's tag encounter blocks.

results.name: squads_activate_all
results.evidence: Zero-argument function (no implicit registers) that walks a datum set via data_iterator_next(), skipping entries whose byte field+0xd is clear, and for squads not yet flagged (DAT_00746f8c+0x430 stride 0xb0, field+0x20 bit 0 clear) calls FUN_00437510(id,-1,-1) - the same activation call used by squad_activate_by_reference.
results.summary: Iterates all pending squads and activates each one that has not already been flagged active.
